name: Abominable Creatures

angles.text: As a human, you see Lordaeron's fallen leadership meet a grim fate: even an esteemed Grand Marshal has become a grotesque undead horror. Captain Truman's grief and nationalistic zeal reflect the trauma of human survivors desperate to reclaim their ancestral home.

As an Alliance member, you see how perilous and isolated the loyalist remnants are in northern Lordaeron's blighted ruins. Their detachments struggle with dwindling hope and the toll of facing overwhelming monstrosities.

As Forsaken, you see the Baron's grotesque transformation as a reminder of how the Scourge mutilated Lordaeron's finest defenders into monstrous abominations. Captain Truman's words reveal the hostility living loyalists hold toward the Undercity's people.

faq.answer: Captain Truman, a human loyalist, makes the request from his post outside the fallen kingdom. He waits anxiously for reinforcements and news of his commander, a revered Grand Marshal who charged into the nearby Ruins of Lordaeron.
faq.q: Who gives the quest Abominable Creatures?

faq.answer: The search takes you into the Ruins of Lordaeron, the shattered capital overrun by Scourge horrors and undead remnants. Captain Truman keeps watch outside the blighted city and asks travelers to find his missing superior there.
faq.q: Where does the quest Abominable Creatures take place?

faq.answer: Captain Truman calls his master the Grand Marshal and praises him as a tall, statuesque military hero. The missing man is also called the Baron, a high-ranking aristocrat and military commander leading the realm's defense.
The Grand Marshal was slain and transformed into a monstrous undead creature in the Ruins of Lordaeron. You find an abomination called the Baron, slay him, and take his severed head.
faq.q: What happened to the Grand Marshal in the Ruins of Lordaeron?

aliases: why does truman yell at you
faq.answer: Captain Truman expects his statuesque commander to be alive and victorious. The grotesque, mutated head of the Baron fills him with horror and revulsion. He furiously accuses you of playing a sick joke and consorting with vile beasts.
faq.q: Why does Captain Truman get angry when you turn in the quest?

aliases: who are the true sons of lordaeron
faq.answer: By “true sons of Lordaeron,” Captain Truman means the rightful human survivors who seek to reclaim their shattered homeland and purge it of all beasts. The phrase reveals his belief that the land belongs to those human survivors.
faq.q: What does Captain Truman mean by the 'true sons of Lordaeron'?

faq.answer: Captain Truman distrusts non-human races and irregular allies, calling them untrustworthy half-breeds and filth. His disdain keeps him from confiding in anyone he does not consider a worthy representative of the realm.
faq.q: Why does Captain Truman refuse to trust 'half breeds'?

sections.body:
Captain Truman keeps watch outside Lordaeron, anxious for long-overdue reinforcements. He calls his superior a renowned Grand Marshal, tall and statuesque, and believes him a formidable fighter. Ordered to hold the line while his commander charged into battle, Truman remains bound by duty.

He distrusts outsiders and scorns those he calls lesser breeds, refusing to rely on local irregulars. When a capable traveler arrives, he asks you to enter the ruins, check on his master's well-being, and learn how the battle fares.
sections.title: A Desperate Vigil

sections.body:
The search takes you into the Ruins of Lordaeron, the shattered capital that fell to the Scourge during the Third War. Captain Truman expects his glorious leader to stand triumphant over the fallen, but the blighted city tells a grimmer story.

Horrors, undead remnants, and abominations roam its broken stone plazas. The ruined streets show what became of the defenders who entered the city. No immaculate knight holds the line; the commander has met a tragic, twisted end among the monstrosities in the courtyards.
sections.title: The Ruins of Lordaeron

sections.body:
The missing commander, whom Captain Truman calls the Baron, has become a grotesque undead monstrosity. You slay the creature and carry the Head of the Baron back to Captain Truman. The severed head of his former lord leaves Truman shocked and horrified, overcome with revulsion.

Unable to accept his commander's fate, he turns on you in bitter outrage and accuses you of siding with monsters. He declares that the true sons of Lordaeron will reclaim their land and purge all beasts.
sections.title: A Horrifying Revelation

summary: At Lordaeron's fallen capital, Captain Truman waits anxiously for reinforcements and news of his missing commander. He believes the revered Grand Marshal still fights in the nearby ruins, and asks a capable traveler to find him. The search reveals the defenders' grim fate and deep hostility among the loyalists.
